## Purpose

Explain the problem and change. Link an issue or OpenSpec change when applicable;
small corrections may say “not applicable” with a short reason.

## Verification

List focused checks and their outcomes. Explain checks not run or not applicable.
Do not claim other operating systems or live security checks ran without evidence.

## Documentation and compatibility

Describe user guidance, generated-project, ownership, migration, or compatibility
impact, or explain why it is not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR targets `develop`; `main` changes follow the maintainer release path.
- [ ] I have explained the change and proportionate verification above.
- [ ] I reviewed relevant documentation and compatibility impact (or explained not applicable).
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under GPL-3.0-only and understand and validated it, including any AI-assisted work.
- [ ] I excluded credentials, private source or data, `.env` files, and unredacted diagnostics from this PR and its fixtures.

Do not attach whole projects or broad environment/configuration dumps.
No additional reviewer, CLA, DCO/sign-off, or tool-specific AI disclosure is required.
See [contribution guidance](https://github.com/voyager163/liftoff/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and the [support and reporting map](https://github.com/voyager163/liftoff/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#support-and-reporting).
Suspected vulnerabilities or secret exposure belong in
[private security reporting](https://github.com/voyager163/liftoff/security/advisories/new),
not this public PR. Sensitive conduct concerns use the separate
[private conduct route](https://github.com/voyager163/liftoff/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#report-a-conduct-concern),
not this PR or vulnerability intake.
